deletion.title: Susa i-akhawunti
deletion.description: I-akhawunti yakho iyavalwa ngokushesha futhi imininingwane yakho yomuntu siqu isulwa unomphela ngemva kwezinsuku ezingu-{{days}}.
consequences: Uyakhishwa kuyo yonke imishini futhi izaziso ze-push ziyayeka ngokushesha.
Ngemva kwezinsuku ezingu-{{days}}, iphrofayela yakho, imininingwane yokuxhumana, imininingwane yomuntu siqu neyezempilo yokubhalisa kwakho, umlando we-GPS, abagijimi obalandelayo nezaziso kuyasulwa.
Imiphumela yemijaho namarekhodi okukhokha kugcinwa kuphela ngendlela engakuveza wena lapho ubuqotho bemijaho noma umthetho kukudinga.
deletion.exportHint: Landa ikhophi yemininingwane yakho kuqala uma uyidinga.
deletion.recoveryHint: Ushintshe umqondo? Kuze kube usuku lokusula, sebenzisa okuthi "Khansela ukususwa kwe-akhawunti okulindile" ekhasini lokungena nge-imeyili nephasiwedi yakho.
deletion.scheduledBody: I-akhawunti yakho ivaliwe futhi ihlelelwe ukusulwa ngo-{{date}}. Usengakhansela ngaphambi kwalokho.
deletion.scheduledBodyNoDate: I-akhawunti yakho ivaliwe futhi ihlelelwe ukusulwa. Usengakhansela ngaphambi kwalokho.
deletion.successBody: I-akhawunti yakho ivaliwe futhi izosulwa ngo-{{date}}. Manje uzokhishwa.
deletion.cancelFailed: Asikwazanga ukukhansela ukususwa. Sicela uzame futhi.

blockers.ACCOUNT_DELETION_LAST_SUPER_ADMIN: Nguwe kuphela umphathi omkhulu osebenzayo. Yenza omunye umsebenzisi abe ngumphathi omkhulu ngaphambi kokususa le akhawunti.
blockers.ACCOUNT_DELETION_ACTIVE_RACES: Nguwe kuphela umhleli osebenzayo womjaho ovuliwe, ovaliwe ekubhaliseni noma oqhubekayo. Engeza omunye umphathi womjaho, noma uqede noma ukhansele umjaho kuqala.

errors.ACCOUNT_DELETION_PASSWORD_REQUIRED: Faka iphasiwedi yakho ukuze ususe i-akhawunti yakho.
errors.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Imizamo miningi kakhulu. Linda imizuzu embalwa bese uzama futhi.
errors.generic: Kukhona okungahambanga kahle. Sicela uzame futhi.
